units.source_text: 我记得父亲出诊用的皮包。

en.t: I remember the leather bag my father used for house calls.

units.source_text: 它不是近来常见的一般医生上班用的皮包，而是旅行用的带大硬底子的皮包。

en.t: It was not the kind of leather bag ordinary doctors often carry to work these days, but a travel bag with a large, hard bottom.

units.source_text: “我写了约莫三十张中学生用的作文纸”这句话，准确的页数现在我也记不清了。

en.t: As for the statement, "I wrote about thirty sheets of composition paper for middle school students," I can no longer remember the exact number of pages.

units.source_text: 因为我二十七岁重抄时，把十六岁写的稿子撕掉了。

en.t: That is because, when I recopied it at the age of twenty-seven, I tore up the manuscript I had written when I was sixteen.
